chapter.heading: Bildad: The Wicked Are Punished
chapter.v:
Then Bildad
the Shuhite answered and said:

“How long
till you put an end to words?Gain understanding, and afterward we will speak.

Why are
we counted as beasts,And regarded as stupid in your sight? [Job 16:10]

You who
tear yourself in anger,Shall the earth be forsaken for you?Or shall the rock be removed from its place?

“Thelight of
the wicked indeed goes out,And the flame of his fire does not shine. [Judg. 18:19; Job 13:5; 29:9; 40:4]

The light
is dark in his tent,And his lamp beside him is put out.

The steps
of his strength are shortened,And his own counsel casts him down. [Job 12:6; Ps. [Jer. 12:1]; Hab.]

For he
is cast into a net by his own feet,And he walks into a snare.

The net
takes him by the heel,And a snare lays hold of him. [Ps. 73:5 2 The]

A noose
is hidden for him on the ground,And a trap for him in the road.

Terrors frighten
him on every side,And drive him to his feet.

His strength
is starved,And destruction is ready at his side.

It devours
patches of his skin;The firstborn of death devours his limbs. [Job 21:23;]

He is
uprooted from the shelter of his tent,And they parade him before the king of terrors. [Job 22:17]

They dwell
in his tent who are none of his;Brimstone is scattered on his dwelling. [Ex. 5:2; Job 22:17; 34:9 i Job 35:3; Mal. 3:14]

His roots
are dried out below,And his branch withers above. [Job 22:18; Ps. 1:1; Prov. 1:10]

The memory
of him perishes from the earth,And he has no name among the renowned. [[Job 31:2, 3; Luke 12:46]]

He is
driven from light into darkness,And chased out of the world. [Ps. 1:4; 35:5; Is. 17:13; Hos. 13:3]

He has
neither son nor posterity among his people,Nor any remaining in his dwellings. [[Ex. 20:5]; Jer. 31:29; Ezek.]

Those in
the west are astonished at his day,As those in the east are frightened. [Ps. 75:8; Is. 51:17; Jer. 25:15; Rev. 14:10; 19:15]

Surely such
are the dwellings of the wicked,And this is the place of him who does not know God.”
